text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Thursday:

- Federal governmment approves economic stimulus package and sends it to parliament. It includes 561 million Swiss francs for infrastructure investment, tax breaks for companies and the introduction of a stamp tax on life insurance policies
- Government approves state broadcasting agency's plans for fourth television channel to complement existing channels in the three language regions: Radio Tropic wins local radio concession in Zurich
- Organisers collect 115,000 signatures for initiative calling for halving of military budget, paving way for a referendum
- Officials from 39 signatories clinch WTO pact on information technology
- Government strengthens position of SRG state broadcasting agency by not requiring it to offer national programming on fourth TV channel but letting it collect advertising income
- Swiss army to help guarantee security at August meeting in Basle on 100th anniversary of first Zionist congress
- Former federal police official accused of leaking information to magazine on wiretapping practices
- Government adopts investment programme, tax breaks and administrative streamlining to try to escape economic crisis
- Nestle boosts 1996 group net to record 3.40 billion Swiss francs
